purpose: Compare a general-purpose LLM with Jev on the same checkmate state and question.

opus_single_case_pair.conditions: Two separate fresh CLI sessions; restricted and safe mode; no tools, code, chess engine, web, or files; one position per request.
opus_single_case_pair.question_template: {side} is the side to move. Using the standard FEN in fen and standard chess rules, is {side} currently checkmated? Answer yes only if {side} king is in check and {side} has zero legal moves that escape check.

batched_general_llm.conditions: The same 40 FEN states and question, shuffled into three prompts of 12 to 14 positions; no tools. This is supportive but not identical to Jev's one-position-per-request condition because cases shared prompt context.
